children.value: > Fact From Story: In the first 24 hours after the Justice Department announced its $4.3 billion settlement with Binance, customers pulled more than $1 billion from the exchange.
> > Fact From Story: Liquidity also dropped 25% in the immediate aftermath of the announcement as market makers pulled back their positions, according to data provider Kaiko.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When customers withdraw money from an exchange, that exchange has fewer assets.
> Fact From Story: With assets of more than $65 billion on the platform, Binance remains the world's largest crypto exchange globally.

> > Fact From Story: But its market share fell from over 60% in February to under 50% in September, "an indication that the exchange may be losing its grip on the industry as regulators continue to pressure it," CoinGecko said.

> > > Fact From Story: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty to violations of the Bank Secrecy Act for failing to implement an effective anti-money laundering program and for willfully violating U.S. economic sanctions.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Being found guilty of legal violations damages a company's reputation.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Market share is a portion of total assets.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company's market share decreases if it loses customers and revenue.
